headline: Our path
subheadline: Tailored software built alongside maritime operators — from first line of code to fleet-scale delivery.

items.title: Company established
items.description: TailoredTech founded to replace rigid vendor stacks and spreadsheet handoffs with custom software shaped around maritime operations.

items.title: Risk assessment platform
items.description: Delivered our digital risk assessment platform and grew the live portfolio to 107+ vessels and over 400 office superintendents across client fleets.

items.title: Four products in market
items.description: Four tailored software products live — digital risk assessments, MOC & PCR, behaviour-based safety, and stevedore damage reporting for maritime operators end to end.
